input: A client reports a damaged delivery and later receives RMA approval. State the claim-submission deadline and the time allowed to send the approved return.
expected_output: The initial damage claim is due within 3 business days after delivery; the approved return must be sent back within 14 calendar days after RMA approval.
context: Clients must report a missing-item or visible-damage claim within three business days after delivery. A valid claim includes the shipment ID, the affected SKU, a short description of the problem and supporting photographs for visible damage. For missing items, the client provides the packing list and the quantity received; photographs are requested only when helpful.

After reviewing evidence, Customer Operations must issue an approval or rejection decision on a return merchandise authorization (RMA) request within two business days. If approved, the client has 14 calendar days from the approval date to send the product back. POZ-2 inspects received ambient returns within two business days of arrival.
